cards.hint: Think about equal speed for all objects
cards.quote: The remarkable observation that all free falling objects fall at the same rate was first proposed by Galileo, nearly 400 years ago.
cards.stem: What did Galileo propose about free falling objects long ago

cards.hint: Recall the constant given for sea level
cards.quote: The acceleration is constant and equal to the gravitational acceleration g which is 9.8 meters per square second at sea level on the Earth.
cards.stem: What is the value of free fall acceleration near sea level

cards.hint: Think about beach ball versus airliner falling together
cards.quote: The weight, size, and shape of the object are not a factor in describing a free fall.
cards.stem: Which object features do not change free fall motion in a vacuum
